questions.inputFormat: Two strings s and t as input
questions.outputFormat: The minimum window substring of s that contains all characters of t
questions.constraints: 1 <= s.length, t.length <= 10^5, s and t consist of lowercase English letters

example.explanation: The minimum window in s that contains all characters of t is "BANC"

questions.title: Find the Middle Element of a Linked List
questions.description: Given a singly linked list, find the middle element of the list. If the list has an even number of elements, return the second middle element.
questions.inputFormat: The input will be the head of the linked list, where each node contains an integer value and a pointer to the next node in the list.
questions.outputFormat: The output will be the value of the middle element of the linked list.
questions.constraints: The linked list will have at least one element and at most 10^5 elements. The values of the nodes will be integers between 1 and 10^5.

example.explanation: The middle element of the linked list is the third element, which has a value of 3.
